question: What enduring role as establisher follows from becoming the bewilderer of the three worlds?
premises: One becomes the bewilderer of the three worlds.
This transformation leads to another role.
That role is to be the establisher always.
inference: Having become the bewilderer of the three worlds, one always becomes the establisher.
plain_english: Having become the bewilderer of the three worlds, he always became the one who establishes.
